title: 群核科技黄晓煌：AI生成空间逼近物理世界，设计师会被取代吗？
speaker: Victor Huang

segments.en: Definitely. So, we believe the Kujala is the framework for data generation and the data generation can benefit the 3D space generation model.
segments.zh: 当然。我们认为Kujala是数据生成的框架，数据生成可以惠及3D空间生成模型。

segments.en: And that is the product for next generation. So, it can generate to help us to generate the whole 3D space.
segments.zh: 那是下一代产品。它可以帮助我们生成整个3D空间。

segments.en: And before we use the tools to generate 3D space and now the AI generated space so it can benefit more and more domain.
segments.zh: 以前我们用工具生成3D空间，现在AI生成空间，可以惠及更多领域。

segments.en: Before the designer, you need to use a lot of time to draw or imagine the space.
segments.zh: 以前设计师需要花大量时间绘制或想象空间。

segments.en: And now I think the future, it can generate by AI and it's more and more close to our physical world.
segments.zh: 现在我认为未来可以由AI生成，并且越来越接近我们的物理世界。

segments.en: And before technology, no matter how hard you work on, it's still a little bit different from the real world.
segments.zh: 以前的技术，无论多么努力，仍然与现实世界有些不同。
